resolution.note: The sole blocking finding read check_writing.md §2 backwards. §2 hard-bans *ritual*/*ceremony* and prescribes **exercise** as the replacement; the judge took the bolded replacement for the banned token. Both refuters killed it independently, on scope and on harm, each verifying against the enforcement machinery rather than the rule text alone: .claude/hooks/eval-class-router.sh L120-128 rewrites ritual/ceremony INTO exercise, curriculum/vocabulary.md:72 states the arrow in plain prose, and §2's own later sentence instructs maintainer blocks to prefer *exercise*. Corpus base rate settles it: ~100 body instances across 25 files plus a directory named curriculum/exercises/. The proposed fix would have swapped a registry-endorsed term for *loop*, which this training uses for a different referent (vocabulary.md:52) — a fix that introduces the error it claims to remove. Body unchanged. The verdict stands as filed; the finding did not survive.
